claims.summary: The fresh-task handoff contains only the B/A template, blank decisions skeleton, frozen prompt, instructions, and manifest; no first-order task, outcome, organizer mapping, key, plaintext, sealed envelope, or unblinded identity is included.

The tracked receipt binds every allowed payload byte, while the verifier rejects file-set drift, links, changed bytes, nonblank outcomes, wrong order, and forbidden private fields without deleting unknown files.

The decisions skeleton is generated from the exact B/A template and remains immutable inside the handoff; the fresh judge edits a separate copy whose template hash, pair set, positions, judge identity, session, and attestations are validated before sealing.
The atomic completion path validates in memory and creates only an AES-256-GCM envelope plus a 0600 key with exclusive writes; no completed judgment plaintext or outcome is emitted.

The real receipt binds 128 blank B/A cases, but the reverse judgment, stable preferences, learned quality rows, adapter weights, held-out wins, and paid-reference parity remain zero; public Scion stays base-only.
